headline: Sudarshan Chemical Industries to Acquire Aluminium Dyes Plant from Clariant
sum: Sudarshan Chemical Industries announced the acquisition of an aluminium dyes manufacturing plant from Clariant, expanding its portfolio in specialty chemicals and dye intermediates.
implication: Vertical or horizontal integration in Indian specialty dyes; review whether CCI approval is triggered under Section 5 ICA 1969 (group revenue thresholds) and examine share-of-supply impact in dye markets.
detail: Sudarshan Chemical Industries, listed on NSE/BSE, announced via press release dated 25 August 2026 its acquisition of Clariant's aluminium dyes manufacturing plant. The transaction expands Sudarshan's production capacity and technical footprint in specialty dyes and pigments. Consideration, regulatory approvals (CCI, stock exchange, antitrust), and closing conditions are expected in the formal acquisition documentation. The deal reflects consolidation in the specialty chemicals sector.
